metadata.agent_last_message:
- Implemented a complete RS274NGC simulator + tracer in `output/` with entrypoint `output/main.py`.
- Supports: `--input`, `--output`, optional `--tool-table`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`, `--parameter-input/--parameter-output`, `--probe-box/--probe-tool`, and `--trace-output` with exactly one of `--trace-time-step/--trace-distance-step/--trace-position-tolerance`.
- Executes RS274NGC.md + `docs/Clarifications.md` behaviors including G0/G1/G2/G3, G53, G10, G28/G30, G38.2 probing, G40/G41/G42 (incl. D0), G43/G49, G54–G59.3, G80–G89 canned cycles (incl. G87 I/J/K defaults and G88 auto retract), M3/M4/M5/M6/M7/M8/M9/M48/M49/M0/M1/M2/M30/M60, parameters, and correct modal state.
- Writes required end-state JSON to `--output` on success/error; exits `0/1/2` per rules.
- When tracing, writes the required delta-trace JSON (with `error_line_number` and `error_block_segment_index`) to `--trace-output` on success/error.

Run: `python output/main.py --input program.ngc --output out.json` (add `--trace-output trace.json --trace-time-step 0.5`, etc., as needed).
